definitions.explanation: Without any doubt or exception; certainly.
Complete and without limitations or conditions.

examples.japanese: {絶対|ぜったい}に{約束|やくそく}を{守|まも}る。
examples.english: I will definitely keep my promise.

examples.japanese: あの{映画|えいが}は{絶対|ぜったい}{見|み}たほうがいい。
examples.english: You should absolutely see that movie.

examples.japanese: {世|よ}の{中|なか}に{絶対|ぜったい}はない。
examples.english: Nothing in this world is absolute.

notes:
{絶対|ぜったい} can be used as an adverb meaning 'absolutely/definitely' or as a noun meaning 'absolute.'

ADVERBIAL USES:
- {絶対|ぜったい}に + positive verb: definitely will
- {絶対|ぜったい}に + negative verb: absolutely won't/never
- {絶対|ぜったい}{大丈夫|だいじょうぶ}: definitely OK

NOUN/ADJECTIVE USES:
- {絶対的|ぜったいてき}: absolute (na-adjective form)
- {絶対|ぜったい}{零度|れいど}: absolute zero
- {絶対|ぜったい}{王政|おうせい}: absolute monarchy

OPPOSITE:
- {相対|そうたい}: relative
